source.label: Takaya Tower · complete original Union Properties plan pack

render.scope: Complete unedited source drawing sheets; original PDF preserved.

introduction: Explore the original Takaya Tower, Kalina, Kaia, Symphony, Harmony and Melody drawings.
selectorLabel: Choose a collection, home or building diagram
note: These six collection packs belong to the Takaya project. Each option preserves its complete original sheet and physical PDF page. Townhouse and Kaia figures describe the whole home across both drawing sheets, with the area-source page identified. Utility areas marked with an asterisk are excluded from published totals. Kaia V-03 prints 8,879.55 sq ft, while its suite and balcony sum to 8,879.90. Minor printed rounding differences remain. Harmony and Symphony have separate collection packs with differing totals for some similarly named layout types. Harmony values were read from visible original tables because the PDF font encoding corrupts text extraction. Confirm the contracted collection, unit and drawing revision.
